kn-IN.text: GPS ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಲೆಕ್ಟ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹೋಗಲಿಲ್ಲ. ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸ್ಥಳವನ್ನು ಕ beteg Tribune keywords ನೀಡಿ.
kn-IN.en: I couldn't locate your position on GPS. Please tell me where you are.

kn-IN.text: ನೀವು ಕೇವಲ ಆ Albion ರಸ್ತೆಯ ಕatience ಹೀಗಿದ್ದೀರಾ? ನಾನು ಹತ್ತಿರದ ಬಿಂದು ಕಂಡುಹೋಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
kn-IN.en: Are you just standing on Albion Road? I still can't find the point.

kn-IN.text: ನೀವು ಇದ್ದೆ genau engish ಅಲ್ಲದೆ, ನಾನು ನೋಡಲಿಲ್ಲ – ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಕಳೆಯಿದ್ದಿ?
kn-IN.en: You're not speaking clear English—I didn't catch that—where did you go?

kn-IN.text: ನೀವು ಈಗ ಯಾವ್‌ ಮೈಲ್‌­‑ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ? ನಾನು ಹ niewielಲಿಲ್ಲ.
kn-IN.en: Which mile street are you on right now? I have no idea.

kn-IN.text: ಎಲ್ಲಿ؟ ನನ್ನ ಮ್ಯಾಪ್ map‑show ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ, ನಿರ್ದೇಶನ Kodagu style ಗೆ ತಿಳಿಸಿ.
kn-IN.en: Where? My map isn't showing—please give me directions in Kodagu style.

kn-IN.text: Hey macha, ninja exact spot yenu? Nanu thoorale kuda huytu illa.
kn-IN.en: Hey dude, what's the exact spot? I couldn't even go far.

kn-IN.text: Bro, ninnappu GPS signal lost aagi, ninna address ellide helu bekku?
kn-IN.en: Bro, my GPS signal got lost—can you tell me your address?

hi-IN.text: भाई, मैं आपका पिन नहीं ढूंढ पा रहा हूँ, अभी आप कहाँ खड़े हो?
hi-IN.en: Brother, I can't find your pin; where are you standing right now?

hi-IN.text: अरे यार, GPS ने आपको दिखा ही नहीं, आप ठीक-ठाक लोकेशन बता सकते हो?
hi-IN.en: Hey buddy, the GPS isn't showing you; can you tell me your exact location?

hi-IN.text: सर, मैं स्टैंड के पास फँस गया हूँ, आपका बिल्डिंग नंबर या लैंडमार्क बता दिजिए?
hi-IN.en: Sir, I'm stuck near the stand; please tell me your building number or landmark.

hi-IN.text: भाईसाहब, आपका मैप पर डॉट नहीं दिख रहा, कृपया स्ट्रीट नाम या नजदीकी चाय Stall बताइए।
hi-IN.en: Brother sir, your dot isn't showing on the map; please tell me the street name or nearest tea stall.

hi-IN.text: सर, मैं आपके gebouw के सामने घूम रहा हूँ, कृपया floor या wing संख्या भेज दो?
hi-IN.en: Sir, I'm wandering in front of your building; please send the floor or wing number.

hi-IN.text: भाई, आपका location pin गायब है, क्या आप nearby metro station या bus stop बता सकते हो?
hi-IN.en: Brother, your location pin is missing; can you tell me the nearby metro station or bus stop?

hi-IN.text: अरे यार, मैं आपको ढूँढ़ रहा हूँ लेकिन signals कमजोर हैं, कृपया landmark जैसे कि कोई बड़ी दुकान या मंदिर का नाम बताओ।
hi-IN.en: Hey buddy, I'm trying to find you but the signals are weak; please tell me a landmark like a big shop or temple name.

hi-IN.text: Bhai, aap kahan ho? GPS dikh nahi raha.
hi-IN.en: Brother/Bro, where are you? My GPS isn't showing.

en-IN.text: Yo, I’m at the landmark you gave but don’t see you anywhere—can you ping me the exact spot?
en-IN.en: Yo, I'm at the landmark you gave me, but I don't see you anywhere—can you send me the exact spot?

en-IN.text: Bro, I’m stuck near the signal, still can’t locate you—where exactly are you waiting?
en-IN.en: Bro, I'm stuck near the signal and still can't locate you—where exactly are you waiting?

en-IN.text: Hey sister, I’m outside the mall gate but you’re nowhere in sight—share your precise location please.
en-IN.en: Hey sister, I'm outside the mall gate but I don't see you—please share your precise location.

en-IN.text: Arre yaar, I’ve circled the block twice, still no sign—tell me the building name or shop nearby?
en-IN.en: Arre yaar, I've circled the block twice and still see nothing—tell me the building name or a nearby shop.

en-IN.text: Sir, I’m at the bus stop you mentioned, yet I don’t spot you—could you describe where you’re standing?
en-IN.en: Sir, I'm at the bus stop you mentioned, but I don't see you—could you describe where you're standing?

en-IN.text: Bhai, I’m near the metro exit, but you’re not visible—any landmark or shop close to you?
en-IN.en: Bhai, I'm near the metro exit, but I can't see you—any landmark or shop close to you?

en-IN.text: Hey, I’m parked near the traffic signal, still can’t find you—send me your live location or a quick description.
en-IN.en: Hey, I'm parked near the traffic signal and still can't find you—send me your live location or a quick description.

en-IN.text: Hey yaar, I’m at your pickup point but can’t spot u—where r u exactly?
en-IN.en: Hey friend, I'm at your pickup location but I can't see you—where are you exactly?

kn-IN.text: Hey, ride‑related, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಫೋನ್‌ ನಂಬರ್ ಕೇಳಬಲ್ಲಿ?
kn-IN.en: Hey, about the ride, can I get your phone number?

kn-IN.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ನಂಬರ್‌ನನ್ನೆ ನೀಡokee?
kn-IN.en: Could you share your mobile number?

kn-IN.text: ಹಲೋ, ನಿಮ್ಮ mobile ನಂಬರ್ ಹೇಳಬಕಿ?
kn-IN.en: Hello, can you tell me your mobile number?

kn-IN.text: ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪರ್ಸನಲ್ ಫೋನ್ ನಂಬರ್=tell me.
kn-IN.en: Please tell me your personal phone number.

kn-IN.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಫೋನ್ ನಂಬರ್ ನೀಡಲಾರಾ? (Please)
kn-IN.en: Can you give your phone number? (Please)

kn-IN.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ cell ನಂಬರ್ hop? tell me pls.
kn-IN.en: Tell me your cell number, please.

hi-IN.text: Bhaiya, app abhi slow chal raha hai... aapka personal number de dijiye na, bas ek minute ka kaam hai
hi-IN.en: Brother, the app is running slow right now... Please give me your personal number, it will just take a minute.

hi-IN.text: Ji, Electronic City tak pahuchne mein der lag rahi hai... aapka number bataiye, waise hi batata hu kahan rukna hai
hi-IN.en: Yes, I'm getting delayed reaching Electronic City... Please give me your number, then I'll let you know where to wait.

hi-IN.text: Aapka number de dijiye please, warna ride automatically cancel ho jaegi... thoda sa cooperation chahiye ji
hi-IN.en: Please give me your number, otherwise the ride will be automatically cancelled... I need a little cooperation.

hi-IN.text: Swalpa thoda time lagega number lenge... app mein error aa raha hai, aapka personal number dena zaruri hai ji
hi-IN.en: It will take a little time to get the number... The app is showing an error, providing your personal number is necessary.

hi-IN.text: Arre yaar, number nahi diye toh photo bhej do na! Thoda mazak thi... lekin seriously, aapka number chahiye ride track karne ke liye
hi-IN.en: Hey buddy, if you don't give the number, send a photo! Just kidding... but seriously, I need your number to track the ride.

hi-IN.text: Aapki meherbani se, ek baar number de dijiye... sirf safety ke liye, promise nahi galat istemal karunga ji
hi-IN.en: With your kindness, please give the number once... Only for safety, I promise I won't misuse it.

hi-IN.text: Number? Pls send fast... meter abhi se chalne wala hai, der nahi ho sakti
hi-IN.en: Number? Please send it fast... the meter is about to start, there can't be any delay.

hi-IN.text: Bhaiya, aapka number nahi toh police se poochna padega later... thoda ji chahyega, de dijiye na!
hi-IN.en: Brother, if you don't give the number, I'll have to ask the police later... Please cooperate a bit, give it!

en-IN.text: Hey yaar, mind giving me your personal number? Might need to reach you quick.
en-IN.en: Hey buddy, could you give me your personal number? I might need to reach you quickly.

en-IN.text: Boss, can you drop your mobile here so I can ping you if anything changes?
en-IN.en: Boss, can you give me your mobile number so I can contact you if anything changes?

en-IN.text: Namaste, please share your phone number for smooth coordination, thanks!
en-IN.en: Hello, please share your phone number so we can coordinate smoothly, thanks!

en-IN.text: Hey sister, could you tell me your contact number? Just in case we lose signal.
en-IN.en: Hey sister, could you tell me your contact number? Just in case we lose signal.

en-IN.text: Bhaiya, apna number de do na, agar rasta mein kuch ho to call kar lunga.
en-IN.en: Brother, please give me your number; I'll call you if anything happens on the road.

en-IN.text: Excuse me madam, may I have your personal mobile? It helps if we need to reconnect.
en-IN.en: Excuse me, ma'am, may I have your personal mobile number? It would be helpful if we need to get back in touch.

en-IN.text: Hey friend, share your phone please, might need to update you on traffic.
en-IN.en: Hey friend, please share your phone number; I might need to update you about traffic.

en-IN.text: Sir, apna contact number bhej dete ho? Thoda sa backup ke liye.
en-IN.en: Sir, could you send me your contact number? Just in case as a backup.

kn-IN.text: ಸರಿ, ನಿನ್ನ ಸಂದೇಶವನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿದ್ದೇನೆ. ಈಗ ಬಂದಿರುವತ್ತು.
kn-IN.en: Okay, I've heard your message. I'm on my way now.

kn-IN.text: ಒಕೆ, ನಿನ್ನ ಮೆಸ್ಸ್ ಶ್ರವಣ ಮಾಡಿದೆ. ಈಗ ಹೋಗ್ತೀನಿ.
kn-IN.en: Okay, your message has been heard. I'll go now.

kn-IN.text: ಸರಿ, ninna message got it. ಈಗ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸ್ಥಳಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇನೆ.
kn-IN.en: Okay, I got your message. I'm heading to your location now.

hi-IN.text: ओके, समझ गया, निकल रहा हूँ।
hi-IN.en: Okay, I understood, I'm leaving.

hi-IN.text: जी, आपका मैसेज पढ़ लिया, अब रास्ते पर हूँ।
hi-IN.en: Yes, I read your message, now I'm on the road.

hi-IN.text: भैया, फँसा नहीं, आ रहा हूँ bas.
hi-IN.en: Bro, I'm not stuck, I'm coming now.

hi-IN.text: Okay boss, samajh gaya, on my way.
hi-IN.en: Okay boss, understood, on my way.

hi-IN.text: ठीक है, चल दिया।
hi-IN.en: Alright, I've left.

hi-IN.text: हन जी, समझ गया, अब पहुँचने वाला हूँ।
hi-IN.en: Yes sir, understood, I'm about to arrive.

hi-IN.text: सुन लीजिए, अब निकल पड़ा हूँ towards your location.
hi-IN.en: Listen up, I have now set off towards your location.

en-IN.text: Gotcha, heading over now.
en-IN.en: Gotcha, heading over now.

en-IN.text: Understood, be right there.
en-IN.en: Understood, be right there.

en-IN.text: Chill yaar, main aa raha hoon.
en-IN.en: Take it easy, I'm on my way.

en-IN.text: Copy that, moving towards you.
en-IN.en: Copy that, moving towards you.

en-IN.text: Sahi hai, chalte hain.
en-IN.en: Alright, let's go.

en-IN.text: Aye, samajh gaya – ab nikal raha hoon.
en-IN.en: Yeah, got it – I'm heading out now.

en-IN.text: All good, driving your way now.
en-IN.en: All good, driving your way now.

en-IN.text: Thik hai, ja raha hoon.
en-IN.en: Okay, I'm on my way.

kn-IN.en: I was waiting at the gate.

kn-IN.text: ಹಲ್ವೆ, ನಾನು ಗೇಟ್‌ಗೆ ಬಂದಿದ್ದೇನೆ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಿಗೆ Waiting.
kn-IN.en: Alright, I have come to the gate, waiting for your signal.

kn-IN.text: ನಾನು ಗೇಟ್‌ನ ಮುನ್ನ ನಿಂತಿದ್ದೇನೆ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ನೋಡಿ.
kn-IN.en: I was standing in front of the gate, please look.

kn-IN.text: ಸರಿ, ಗೇಟ್‌ ಹತ್ತಿರದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಂತಿದ್ದೇನೆ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಿಗೆ Waiting.
kn-IN.en: Okay, I was standing at the gate, waiting for your signal.
